when_to_use: 展示层级路径并支持回跳
prompt_en: Build a single Breadcrumb trail, not a full page. Structure: Home / Library / Data / current page, separated by chevrons; the last crumb is plain text, earlier ones are links. Interaction: hover shows underline on links, clicking a crumb flashes it. States: link, hover, current (muted, not clickable). Motion: none required. Do not wrap to two lines. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个面包屑，不是整页。结构：Home / Library / Data / 当前页，用右箭头分隔；最后一级是纯文本，前几级是链接。交互：悬停链接显示下划线，点击闪示反馈。状态：链接、悬停、当前（灰色不可点）。动效：可无。不要折行。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

prompt_en: Build a single Pagination bar, not a full page. Structure: prev arrow, page numbers 1 2 3 … 8, next arrow, with the active page filled; ellipsis collapses middle pages. Interaction: click a page to switch active, arrows step, ellipsis is inert. States: active, hover, disabled arrows at ends. Motion: 120ms active transition. Do not use a dropdown for page numbers. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个分页器，不是整页。结构：前/后箭头、页码 1 2 3 … 8，活动页填充；省略号折叠中间页。交互：点页码切换活动页，箭头步进，省略号不可点。状态：活动、悬停、两端箭头禁用。动效：120ms 活动过渡。不要用下拉选页。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

prompt_en: Build a single Bottom Navigation bar, not a full page. Structure: a phone-width bar fixed at the bottom of the demo area with four items (icon + label: Home, Search, Add, Me), the active one accent-colored with a small top indicator. Interaction: click to switch active item. States: active, inactive, badge on one item (red dot with count). Motion: 150ms color transition. Do not make it full-page width. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个底部导航栏，不是整页。结构：演示区内手机宽度的底部栏，四项（图标+文字：首页、搜索、发布、我的），活动项强调色并带小顶部指示。交互：点击切换活动项。状态：活动、非活动、某项带红点角标（含数字）。动效：150ms 颜色过渡。不要做成整页宽。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 后台左侧一级/二级导航
prompt_en: Build a single Sidebar Navigation, not a full page. Structure: a 180px vertical menu with five items and icons, one active with accent left bar; one group (Settings) expands to show two indented sub-items. Interaction: click to switch active, click group to expand/collapse. States: active, hover, expanded group, sub-item selected. Motion: 150ms expand. Do not use tabs styling. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个侧边导航菜单，不是整页。结构：180px 宽纵向菜单，五项带图标，活动项左侧强调色竖条；「设置」组可展开两个缩进子项。交互：点击切换活动项，点组展开/收起。状态：活动、悬停、组展开、子项选中。动效：150ms 展开。不要做成标签样式。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

prompt_en: Build a single Top Navbar, not a full page. Structure: a full-width bar with a logo block on the left, four center links (one active with underline), and a search icon + avatar on the right. Interaction: hover links get underline, click sets active. States: active, hover, right-side icons. Motion: 150ms underline slide optional. Do not include a hamburger on desktop width. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个顶部导航栏，不是整页。结构：全宽栏，左侧 logo 块，中间四个链接（活动项带下划线），右侧搜索图标 + 头像。交互：悬停链接出现下划线，点击设为活动。状态：活动、悬停、右侧图标。动效：下划线 150ms 滑动（可选）。桌面宽度不要放汉堡按钮。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

prompt_en: Build a single Anchor Navigation rail, not a full page. Structure: a vertical list of five section links on the right edge with a small scrollable demo content area beside it; the link for the section currently scrolled into view is accent-highlighted. Interaction: clicking a link scrolls the demo area to that section and highlights; scrolling updates highlight. States: active link, hover, scroll-synced highlight. Motion: 200ms smooth scroll. Do not use a dropdown. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个锚点导航，不是整页。结构：右缘五个章节链接的纵向列表，旁边配一个可滚动的小演示内容区；当前滚动到视口的章节对应链接强调色高亮。交互：点链接滚动演示区到对应章节并高亮，滚动时高亮随动。状态：活动链接、悬停、滚动联动高亮。动效：200ms 平滑滚动。不要用下拉。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 层级很深时折叠中间路径
prompt_en: Build a single Breadcrumb with Ellipsis, not a full page. Structure: Home / … / Level-6 / current, where … is a small button that expands the collapsed crumbs in place when clicked. Interaction: click … to expand all levels inline, expanded crumbs become normal links. States: collapsed (… button), expanded, current crumb. Motion: 150ms inline expand. Do not navigate away. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个折叠面包屑，不是整页。结构：Home / … / 第六级 / 当前页，其中 … 是小按钮，点击后就地展开被折叠的层级。交互：点 … 内联展开全部层级，展开后变普通链接。状态：折叠（… 按钮）、展开、当前级。动效：150ms 内联展开。不要跳转页面。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 空间紧张时的简化翻页
prompt_en: Build a single Compact Pagination, not a full page. Structure: prev arrow, a '3 / 8' text readout, next arrow in one slim row. Interaction: arrows step the counter and disable at bounds. States: default, hover, disabled at first/last page. Motion: 100ms readout swap. Do not show individual page number buttons. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个迷你分页，不是整页。结构：一行瘦条：前箭头、「3 / 8」文字读数、后箭头。交互：箭头步进读数，到边界时禁用。状态：默认、悬停、首末页禁用。动效：100ms 读数切换。不要显示单独页码按钮。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 汉堡按钮展开的侧滑导航
prompt_en: Build a single Drawer Navigation, not a full page. Structure: a demo area with a hamburger button; clicking slides in a left drawer (overlaying dim scrim) listing five nav items. Interaction: hamburger opens, scrim click or × closes, item click highlights and closes. States: closed, open (scrim + drawer), item hover. Motion: 250ms slide + scrim fade. Do not push the content — overlay it. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个抽屉导航，不是整页。结构：演示区含汉堡按钮，点击后左侧滑入抽屉（覆盖暗色遮罩），列出五个导航项。交互：汉堡打开，点遮罩或 × 关闭，点项高亮并关闭。状态：关闭、打开（遮罩 + 抽屉）、项悬停。动效：250ms 滑入 + 遮罩淡入。不要推挤内容——用覆盖。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 长页面滚动后出现的回顶按钮
prompt_en: Build a single Back-to-Top control, not a full page. Structure: a small scrollable demo area (fixed height with tall content) with a circular floating button appearing bottom-right after scrolling down. Interaction: scrolling down past a threshold shows the button, clicking smooth-scrolls to top and hides it. States: hidden (at top), visible (scrolled), hover. Motion: 200ms fade/slide-in, smooth scroll back. Do not show the button while at the top. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个回到顶部控件，不是整页。结构：固定高度的长内容小滚动区，向下滚动后右下角出现圆形悬浮按钮。交互：滚动超过阈值显示按钮，点击平滑滚回顶部并隐藏。状态：隐藏（在顶部）、可见（已滚动）、悬停。动效：200ms 淡入/滑入，平滑滚回。在顶部时不要显示按钮。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 后台多页面以页签记录访问路径
prompt_en: Build a single Visited Tabs Bar, not a full page. Structure: a row of small route tabs (Dashboard active, Orders, Users) each closable with ×, plus an × close-all at the end; below a one-line panel showing the active route. Interaction: click tab to activate, × removes it, close-all empties and shows a placeholder. States: active, inactive, hover ×, empty state. Motion: 150ms removal fade. Do not add new tabs dynamically. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个页签导航，不是整页。结构：一行小型路由页签（Dashboard 活动、Orders、Users），每个可带 × 关闭，末尾有「全部关闭」；下方一行面板显示当前路由。交互：点页签激活，× 移除，全部关闭后显示占位。状态：活动、非活动、悬停 ×、空状态。动效：150ms 移除淡出。不要动态新增页签。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。
